corrections.reason: The printed text reads እሰቀላለሁ ('I will be crucified', passive stem matching ⟪ወይሰቅልዎ⟫ and Col 2 L02 እሰቀላለሁ), with 6th-order እ and 1st-order ቀ.
The printed glyph is ኀ in the proverbial expression የባለጸጋ ልጅ ኀዘን ቢነግሩት አደን እንዲሉ ('when they tell a rich man's child of mourning/grief [ኀዘን], he speaks of hunting [አደን]').
The printed glyph is 6th-order አልፍ (እ) in ለምእመናን, not ዐይን (ዕ).
The printed glyph at the line break is ካ without a top crown, forming ይካሰሱብን ጀመር.
